hero.title: The HQ for your <ember>CTFs</ember> and your red team.
hero.subtitle: PwnForge organises your challenges, your writeups and your team in one clear space. From solo HTB grinding to a 48h jeopardy CTF, keep everyone in sync.

trust.exportAnytime: Export your data at any time

product.title: Built for how red teams actually work.

workspaces.title: Workspaces per platform or CTF
workspaces.description: A dedicated space for every event or platform: HTB, THM, jeopardy. Solo or as a team, with its own challenges, tags and permissions.

kanban.title: Challenge kanban
kanban.description: Track every challenge from "to do" to "solved", assign teammates, categorise with system and custom tags.

writeups.title: Markdown writeups
writeups.description: Split Markdown / preview editor. Private draft or published to the whole team. Notes and attachments included.

realtime.title: Real-time dashboard
realtime.description: The activity feed shows who solved what, flags landing, new members, live during the event.

teams.title: Teams & invitations
teams.description: Invitation links, permission levels (Owner, Admin, Member, Viewer), and linking teams to workspaces.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.description: Progress by category, by difficulty, team velocity and detailed personal stats.

solutions.title: One tool, four ways to <ember>pwn</ember>.
solutions.subtitle: From the solo player to the corporate red team, PwnForge adapts to your team's size and pace.

solo.title: Solo player
solo.description: Grind HTB, THM or Root-Me at your own pace. Keep your writeups sorted by category and find any technique in seconds.

ctfTeam.title: CTF team
ctfTeam.description: Coordinate 5 to 50 players during a 48h jeopardy. Who takes what, who is stuck, which flags land, live.

studentClub.title: Student club
studentClub.description: Train newcomers, follow each member's progress and build a writeup base that outlives every intake.

redTeam.title: Professional red team
redTeam.description: Centralise engagements, methodology and team knowledge in a private space, self-hostable if needed.

community.title: Join the teams that are climbing.

finalCta.title: Ready to pwn your next flag?
finalCta.subtitle: Create your first workspace in under a minute.
